summary: Mars Path Finder will help YOUR astronauts navigate the rough surface of Mars! Astronauts need to make sure that every part of the mission has the least amount of friction possible, and this tool will help make mars walks easy as breeze.
details:
This program uses map data from mars to help astronauts navigate the surface of mars. By using the height map and off off that, generating a slope-heatmap. The algorithm wull try to find the easiest path to the target.

You pick a starting location and an end location and press Get Path and the path is calculated and displayed on the map.

The program is written entirely in python runs natively on the computer. No hardware attatched.
